title: HRestConnector
description: This connector retrieves and parses JSON data from a REST service

sourceConnectorName.title: Source connector
sourceConnectorName.description: Upstream connector this transform reads from (if applicable)

cacheOnDisk.title: Cache data on disk?
cacheOnDisk.description: Store connector output as Hop binary rows under the server data path. Reloads only when the connector changes or a full presentation refresh is requested.

useCallerBearer.title: Use caller Bearer token
useCallerBearer.description: Send Authorization: Bearer from the logged-in user (Ship/Harbor APIs). Requires OAuth session or Bearer login.

authorizationHeader.title: Authorization header
authorizationHeader.description: Optional static header value, e.g. Bearer ${SERVICE_TOKEN}. Used when Use caller Bearer is off or no user token is available.

rowsElement.title: Rows JSON path
rowsElement.description: JSON object property that holds the row array. Leave empty or use '.' for a root JSON array (e.g. Ship GET /api/runs).

fields.title: Output fields
fields.description: JSON tags mapped to row columns (tag, name, Hop type, format)
